posts.angle: better ad tooling still needs cleaner billing and payment control
posts.hook: Ad platforms keep adding smarter tools.
posts.copy:
Ad platforms keep adding smarter tools. Google's shift of Display Ads into Demand Gen shows how much the foundation of modern marketing is being rebuilt around AI-driven automation.

For media buyers and founders, better targeting tools do not solve the underlying operational friction of billing. If your payment setup is not as agile as your campaigns, you risk account pauses and missed opportunities during scaling.

RichXPay provides the payment layer for this workflow. By funding virtual cards with USDT or USDC, you can manage spend across Meta and Google Ads without the delays of traditional cross-border banking.
sourceTitles: Google Display Ads has a new home in Demand Gen.
Here's how AI is rebuilding the foundation of modern marketing.
